writeup: YouTheFan's regulation 2x4 all-wood cornhole set comes with eight logo bags and a choice of Michigan Wolverines (MPN 4606773) or Texas A&M Aggies boards, UV-printed in the USA. Woot has the set for $126.99. Stadium Allstar lists the Michigan option in stock at $269.99, Dick's Sporting Goods has the A&M boards at $299.99, and Sports Unlimited wants $305.54 for either school, which makes this price about 52 percent below the lowest of those, or $143 less than Stadium Allstar. Woot shows only 4 left with a limit of 10 per customer.
amazon_match_notes: Verifier marked amazon_asin_verified B0CSTFSWYG as an exact match for the YouTheFan Michigan & Texas A&M 2x4 cornhole line.
